entries.fact: QuantumCircuit.assign_parameters accepts a mapping or an ordered iterable and supports inplace assignment. Suggestions must preserve the declared parameter ordering.
qiskit.qasm2.dumps exports a supported QuantumCircuit as OpenQASM 2 text. Export can fail for unsupported operations; do not assume every circuit is serializable.
generate_preset_pass_manager accepts optimization_level, target and seed_transpiler. Preserve explicit target and seed settings when proposing API changes.
